parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. <short pause> Psalm ninety-one, verse one.

Lord, I come into Your presence tonight, into the secret place where You shelter those who trust You. <short pause> Under Your shadow I am safe. <short pause> I rest here, hidden and held, through all the hours of darkness. <short pause> Amen.
